name: MeshSDF
signature: public sealed class MeshSDF : Asset, IMeshFeature

docs.summary: A Signed Distance Field for a mesh, stored as a single channel 16 bit 3D texture of cubic voxels. Distances are measured in mesh-local units. Sign convention: negative inside, positive outside.
docs.remarks: Created by [`SDFGenerator`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.MeshFeatures.Generation.SDFGenerator) during asset import with the project's SDF settings. Treat as read-only, changing those settings reimports every mesh. Volume sampling (GPU shader): uvw = (localPos - Bounds.Min) / (Bounds.Max - Bounds.Min); distance = texture(volume, uvw).r * MaxDistance;

docs.summary: Signed distances divided by [`MaxDistance`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.MeshFeatures.MeshSDF~MaxDistance), as signed normalized shorts. Layout matches [`Resolution`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.MeshFeatures.MeshSDF~Resolution).
World-agnostic bounds the volume covers, in mesh-local coordinates.
Edge length of every voxel, in mesh-local units.
The distance a stored value of one stands for, the diagonal of [`Bounds`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Bounds).
